svg.aria-label: Decision tree titled Which construct do I reach for, rooted at the question What are you modelling. A shared bus drops to nine branch questions, five in a top band and four in a second band reached by a connector routed down the right margin: Value type (Immutable data with equality by content), leaves record Money(BigDecimal amount, Currency currency), class for a superclass or mutable state, enum for a closed set. Contract (who implements it and is the set closed), leaves interface for an open set, sealed interface Verdict permits DocumentVerdict, ScreeningVerdict, ReviewVerdict, WealthVerdict, functional interface with one abstract method, abstract class for shared state. Constant (does the set change without a redeploy), leaves static final compile-time literal, enum RestrictionType, config property tunable limit. Error signal (can the caller do anything about it), leaves unchecked InsufficientFundsException, checked for a recoverable I/O boundary, Optional where absent is normal, Result of T and E where a reason must travel with the failure. Number (is it money), leaves minor-unit long a stake of 420 minor units, BigDecimal Money.amount at scale 2, int or long for counts and ids, and double marked in the degraded red style as never for money. Text (does it need wiping from memory), leaves String a StatusCode value, StringBuilder a built payout file line, char array a password, byte array a PSP callback payload. Time (instant on the timeline or a human date), leaves Instant LedgerEntry.postedAt, LocalDate a date of birth, ZonedDateTime an operator-facing PaymentRun window, epoch millis only at a wire boundary. Copy (must the copy be independent of later writes), leaves unmodifiable view via Collections.unmodifiableList which still sees later writes, List.copyOf an independent snapshot, deep copy for mutable elements, immutable rebuild via a withX method. Nested type (does it need the enclosing instance), leaves static nested PaymentRun.Item, inner which needs this dollar zero, local or anonymous for one call site, lambda a Comparator on LedgerEntry.postedAt.

highlight — the root question that starts every decision
annotation panel — a branch decision point
primary — a concrete construct, with its QuizStakes instance
degraded — the construct to avoid for this case
structural edge — question leads to branch, branch leads to leaf
